title: The dashboard header shows gates removed this week beside reverts this week
description: Starts the real control plane over a checkout and Postgres: the master records a lesson with `master lesson add --enforceable`, the loop's lessons-to-code pass files its item through the API, a batch-gate revert of another item is on the gate record, and the item's delivery removes the lesson. /api/status's thisWeek then reads one revert and one gate removed, and the rendered dashboard header shows 'This week: 1 revert GY-N · 1 gate removed GY-M' with each item a link; while both read 0 it shows no week line. No provider credentials, accounts or network.

steps.name: gates removed this week beside reverts this week
